about: The loop's base admission policy for step 04. It is not admission-baseline@1, which is still to be ruled (action-state-group/evidencebook-skills#51).

rows.statement: above T0 the seller's history card is present and signed by the seller's key
the card's checkpoint is within the freshness window of the offer
no half, no deal above T0: above T0 at least one claim is held on a verified counterparty half
claims held reach the tier's count; halves from keys under the seller's own controller declaration are not claims held
an adjudication against the seller is never ignored: with this buyer it refuses, with anyone else it limits to T0
